An original open-world game set in the fictional coastal city of San Aurelia. All characters, brands and places are invented. Built entirely from procedural 3D and synthesized audio.

Procedural (non-photoreal) art; humanoids are rigid-skinned procedural models; ragdolls are scripted falls; spatial audio uses distance + panning without full occlusion; police helicopter and roadblocks are basic; photo-to-avatar samples colours only.
Firearms, 18 further story missions, property businesses beyond one café share, friend dates/house visits, swimming dives, cockpit instrument detail, photoreal assets, voice-acted dialogue.

RIVORA is an original game. San Aurelia, its people, companies, vehicles and gangs are fictional; no real celebrities, brands or likenesses are used. The default hero's look was configured from reference portraits supplied by the player-owner; those photos are not included in this game.
All geometry procedurally generated in code (this project).
Synthesized live with the Web Audio API (this project). Optional spoken lines use the browser's own speech voices.
